fields.body: At T3, 1.4 m below grade, exposed an active 150 mm water main crossing the pump feeder route. Stopped excavation and protected the pipe. Utility locator witnessed the crossing. Planned dry excavation cannot proceed safely.
Original contract survey U-11 and bore logs for T3 show no utility crossing to 2 m depth. Survey envelope includes the exposed location.

Confirmed in the field: active water main at T3 is absent from the contract utilities survey U-11. Keep the trench secure while we design a crossing support detail. No contractor installation error caused this conflict; track protection and standby records for project review.
